workflow_id: wf_web_005
steps:
  - id: fetch_comment_payload
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/forum/comments/submitted"
      method: GET
    output: comment_payload

  - id: validate_comment
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{comment_payload}}"
      schema: "comment_schema"
    output: validation_result

  - id: authenticate_posting_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      user_id: "{{comment_payload.user_id}}"
      method: "session_token"
    output: auth_result

  - id: publish_comment
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: "/api/forum/threads/{{comment_payload.thread_id}}/comments"
      method: POST
      payload:
        comment: "{{comment_payload}}"
        auth_token: "{{auth_result.token}}"
    output: publish_response

  - id: extract_publish_status
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: "{{publish_response}}"
      field: "status"
    output: publish_status

  - id: notify_moderation_team
    op: notify_user
    params:
      recipient: "moderation_team"
      subject: "New comment requires review"
      message: "A new comment has been posted by user {{comment_payload.user_id}} on thread {{comment_payload.thread_id}}. Publish status: {{publish_status}}. Please review."
